heading: COMPANY SNAPSHOT
text: Larsen & Toubro Limited (L&T) is an Indian multinational conglomerate headquartered in Mumbai, founded in 1938 by Danish engineers Henning Holck-Larsen and Søren Kristian Toubro and incorporated in 1946. Today the group operates in more than 50 countries and is listed on the NSE and BSE (ticker: LT), with no single majority shareholder.

heading: Infrastructure (EPC)
text: Engineering, procurement and construction of buildings & factories, transportation infrastructure, heavy civil works, power transmission & distribution, and water & renewable energy projects.

heading: Energy -Hydrocarbon & Power
text: End-to-end EPC for upstream, midstream and downstream oil & gas, and power generation infrastructure.

heading: Hi-Tech Manufacturing & Defence Engineering
text: Design, manufacture and supply of engineered equipment for process plants, nuclear and green-hydrogen facilities, marine and land defence platforms, aerospace systems, and precision electronics for defence, security and space.

heading: IT & Technology Services
text: Global IT services, digital solutions, engineering R&D, e-commerce/digital platforms, data centres and semiconductor chip-design solutions, delivered through group entities such as LTIMindtree and L&T Technology Services.

heading: Financial Services
text: Retail finance, wholesale finance and investment management, delivered through L&T Finance Holdings.

heading: Development Projects & Realty
text: Roads and transmission assets, the Hyderabad Metro Rail project, power development projects, and premium residential & commercial real estate through L&T Realty.

heading: INDUSTRY
text: L&T operates at the intersection of engineering, construction, heavy manufacturing, information technology, defence and financial services -commonly classified under the capital goods / infrastructure & engineering sector in India, serving customers across more than 50 countries.
